raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Enabling the AdaLN sidecar cache on FastH3 (`--minimax-h3-adaln-cache-path`) always fails, even though FastH3 is a supported pipeline:

- `FastH3PipelineConfig.validate_server_args` raises on any explicit `--model-variant` (FastH3 ships a single t2va-distilled partition, so the flag does not apply).
- The sidecar branch in `TransformerLoader` required `model_variant in ("fl2va", "ref2va")` and raised `MiniMax H3 AdaLN cache requires --model-variant fl2va or ref2va` otherwise.

With FastH3 the variant is therefore always `None`, so the two checks deadlock the only supported FastH3 + sidecar path.

## Modifications

- Add `_resolve_minimax_h3_adaln_variant(model_variant)`: an unset variant now falls back to `fl2va`, the same default the base `MiniMaxH3PipelineConfig` already selects when `--model-variant` is omitted. Unsupported values still raise the existing error.
- Use it in the sidecar branch instead of the inline `in ("fl2va", "ref2va")` check.
- Add unit tests covering the three boundary cases (unset -> `fl2va`, supported passthrough, unsupported rejection) to the existing `test_minimax_h3_adaln_cache.py`.

## Accuracy Tests

Validated end to end on a single A100-SXM4-80GB (FastH3 4-step, 1344x768, 5 s, Triton VSA fallback). Output is **bit-exact** with the pre-patch baseline (`MD5 60e0244b...` identical), so the fix only unblocks the path without changing numerics.

`python -m pytest python/sglang/multimodal_gen/test/unit/test_minimax_h3_adaln_cache.py` -> 26 passed.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Same prompt/seed/resolution/steps, VAE-resident + layerwise offload of `dit text_encoder`:

| run | e2e (s) | peak VRAM (MB) | DiT host pinned (GiB) | output MD5 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| baseline (no sidecar) | 84.96 | 20210 | 65.15 | 60e0244b... |
| + AdaLN sidecar | 85.67 (+0.8%, noise) | 19236 (-0.97 GiB) | 40.91 (-24.24) | 60e0244b... bit-exact |

The 24.2 GiB of `adaln_proj` weights no longer need to be re-streamed per request; the saving is hidden behind compute for this single-request, compute-bound case, so wall time is unchanged while VRAM and host pinned memory drop.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the Format code with pre-commit.
- [x] Add unit tests according to the Run and add unit tests.
- [ ] Update documentation according to Write documentations.
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to Test the accuracy and Benchmark the speed.
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style guidance.

files.patch:
@@ -69,6 +69,18 @@ def _minimax_h3_adaln_cache_key_filter(name: str) -> bool:
     return ".adaln_proj.linear." not in name
 
 
+def _resolve_minimax_h3_adaln_variant(model_variant: str | None) -> str:
+    # FastH3 ships a single t2va-distilled partition and rejects an explicit
+    # --model-variant, so an unset variant must fall back to the default fl2va
+    # partition used for checkpoint selection.
+    variant = model_variant or "fl2va"
+    if variant not in ("fl2va", "ref2va"):
+        raise ValueError(
+            "MiniMax H3 AdaLN cache requires --model-variant fl2va or ref2va"
+        )
+    return variant
+
+
 def _default_quantized_attention_backend(
     quant_spec: TransformerQuantLoadSpec, server_args: ServerArgs
 ) -> AttentionBackendEnum | None:
@@ -425,14 +437,11 @@ def load_customized(
                 raise ValueError(
                     "--minimax-h3-adaln-cache-path is only supported by MiniMax H3"
                 )
-            if component_server_args.model_variant not in ("fl2va", "ref2va"):
-                raise ValueError(
-                    "MiniMax H3 AdaLN cache requires --model-variant fl2va or ref2va"
-                )
-            init_params["adaln_cache_path"] = adaln_cache_path
-            init_params["adaln_cache_model_variant"] = (
+            variant = _resolve_minimax_h3_adaln_variant(
                 component_server_args.model_variant
             )
+            init_params["adaln_cache_path"] = adaln_cache_path
+            init_params["adaln_cache_model_variant"] = variant
             checkpoint_key_filter = _minimax_h3_adaln_cache_key_filter
         if component_server_args.minimax_h3_adaln_online:
             if not is_minimax_h3:

@@ -14,6 +14,9 @@
     maybe_init_distributed_environment_and_model_parallel,
     model_parallel_is_initialized,
 )
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.loader.component_loaders.transformer_loader import (
+    _resolve_minimax_h3_adaln_variant,
+)
 from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.models.dits.minimax_h3_adaln_cache import (
     MiniMaxH3AdalnCache,
 )
@@ -564,3 +567,23 @@ def test_weights_updater_rejects_tensor_update_in_online_cache_mode(tmp_path):
     assert not ok
     assert "update_weights_from_disk" in message
     assert torch.equal(model.probe, torch.zeros(2))
+
+
+def test_adaln_variant_defaults_to_fl2va_when_unset():
+    """FastH3 rejects --model-variant, so an unset variant must still resolve.
+
+    FastH3PipelineConfig forbids passing --model-variant while the sidecar
+    branch used to require one explicitly, deadlocking the only supported
+    FastH3 + AdaLN cache path.
+    """
+    assert _resolve_minimax_h3_adaln_variant(None) == "fl2va"
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("variant", ["fl2va", "ref2va"])
+def test_adaln_variant_passes_through_supported_values(variant):
+    assert _resolve_minimax_h3_adaln_variant(variant) == variant
+
+
+def test_adaln_variant_rejects_unsupported_value():
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="fl2va or ref2va"):
+        _resolve_minimax_h3_adaln_variant("t2va")
